LESSON: GRAMMAR IN USE 9.3.1 ADVERBS

Grade: Grade 6
Subject: ENGLISH LANGUAGE
Strand: Strand 9
Topic 9.3: Grammar in Use 9.3.1 Adverbs

SECTION 1: WELCOME

• Today’s class: Grammar in Use 9.3.1 Adverbs
• How we learn: Teach → Worked example → Try this
• Use point notes. Show working. Then take the quiz.
• Big question: How do we show where, how, when and how many times an action occurs?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

1. identify adverbs in oral and written texts
2. use adverbs to express different meanings correctly

SECTION 3: CLASS STUDY (TEACH → EXAMPLE → TRY)

▸ Grammar in Use 9.3.1 Adverbs

• Listen to a model.
• Study the example.
• Then produce your own example.

▸ Grammar in Use 9.3.1 Adverbs

Teach
• Focus skill: identify adverbs in oral and written texts.
• Use complete sentences.
• Speak clearly; write neatly.

Worked example
• Model sentence 1 about Grammar in Use 9.3.1 Adverbs.
• Model sentence 2 using a Kenyan school example.
• Model dialogue: A: “…?”  B: “…”

Try this
• Write 5 original sentences on this skill.
• Say one 30-second oral example to a partner.


SECTION: QUICK EXAMPLES

• One clear model for Grammar in Use 9.3.1 Adverbs
• One Kenyan school/home example

SECTION: PRACTICE NOW

1. Write 5 sentences.
2. Do one oral practice with a partner.
3. Correct spelling/punctuation.

SECTION: WORK TO DO

1. Revision sheet: meaning + 5 examples + 5 practice items.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. How do we show where, how, when and how many times an action occurs?
2. What are some of the words you could use to talk more about an action?

SECTION: REMEMBER

• Model first, then try.
• Use complete sentences.

• Next: complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Classroom study notes (Strategy 2)
